story.title: How I use LLMs to learn complex topics

draft:
I've been experimenting with using large language models to learn complex topics. 
I find that LLMs can provide a good starting point for understanding difficult concepts. 
Key benefits include:
* Faster research
* Better context 
What role do you think LLMs will play in the future of learning?
